description: 航（wataru）的建置配方：build_character.py 依這份檔案從頭產出角色。每個步驟的輸入輸出見 design/03-art-pipeline/CHARACTER_PIPELINE.md。
name: 航

design.prompt: Anime cel-shaded character art in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat colors, bold clean black outlines, hard-edged two-tone shading, saturated neon accents. Full body, strict side view facing right, standing upright with the arms relaxed at the sides and empty hands, the far-side leg hidden behind the near leg. Wataru, an eleven year old frail sick boy, about five heads tall, thin and small: messy dark hair, pale skin, a light mint-green oversized pajama set, white socks, a thin blanket-like sweater. Empty hands.
